professionalSummary: Program manager with three years of experience leading API deprecation programmes at a platform company, managing deprecation plans, developer communication schedules, and coordinating migration guides and tooling.
experienceHighlights: Led five API deprecation programmes using the platform's program method, delivering deprecation plans and developer communication schedules.
Answered external developers' questions at 32 monthly developer calls, ensuring all open questions were addressed in writing within five days.
Coordinated API teams' migration guides and tooling via the program tracker, recording readiness against each milestone.
Prepared shutdown readiness reviews, documenting responsibilities and confirming shutdown dates set by platform leadership.
Authored closure reports with program boundary statements and traffic evidence, approved by the head of platform programs.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Deprecation plan with communication schedule; two developer call transcripts with follow‑up logs; shutdown readiness review with leadership date decision; closure report with traffic evidence – all archived as verification trail.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample sources establish the candidate’s experience and responsibilities for each required activity; interview notes confirm handling of hostile questions but do not provide additional evidence of program ownership or deployment environments.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review is required to assess fit based on the evidence and gaps identified.

evidence.text: Program manager at a platform company for three years, running five API deprecation programmes under the platform's program method with their deprecation plans and developer communication schedules.

Work sample: one deprecation plan with its communication schedule, two developer call transcripts with follow-up logs, one shutdown readiness review with the leadership's date decision and one closure report, with the archive references as a verification trail.

Answered the external developers' questions at thirty-two monthly developer calls under the communication standard; the call transcripts and the follow-up logs are in the developer relations archive, with every open question answered in writing within the standard's five days.

Interview note: given a hostile question from a panel member playing an external developer, the candidate restated the question in the developer's terms, gave the shutdown date and the migration guide section that covered the developer's case, said which two items were not yet decided and when they would be, and offered to follow up in writing within five days.
Coordinated the API teams' migration guides and tooling through the program tracker, with the guide and tool readiness recorded against each deprecation milestone.

Prepared the shutdown readiness review for each deprecation; the shutdown dates were set by the platform leadership, recorded on the review together with which checks were mine and which the API teams'.
Wrote the closure report for each programme with the program boundary statement and the traffic evidence that the old version was unused, accepted by the head of platform programs.
